acceptance_matrix.criterion: Credential variables are source-scoped and least-privilege where the provider supports scopes.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: Exactly one actual source variable is defined, bound only to CollegeFootballData SRC-002/SRC-059; no cross-provider reuse or scope-introspection claim is made, and use is limited to documented read operations/minimum approved tier.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Rotation/revocation ownership and expiry handling are documented.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: Four accountable external roles, a 90-day project review cadence, provider/event-driven rotation, revocation triggers, deletion, readiness invalidation, and BLOCKED_CREDENTIAL expiry behavior are explicit.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: No credential value appears in Git-tracked files or evidence.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: The contract contains names/states only, all value flags are false, and it consumes protected POST-SUBTASK-005 evidence with zero tracked-secret matches.
